summary: Brouhard co-introduced an Oakland Unified School District resolution on November 1, 2023, calling for a ceasefire and hostage release in Israel and Palestine, making her an early local advocate for halting the war. CAIR Action, which evaluates candidates on civil rights and Gaza ceasefire positions, endorsed her in the general election. Her personal introduction of that early ceasefire resolution, alongside the CAIR Action endorsement, documents a concrete commitment to Palestinian justice at the district level.
